pages.text: Mates, kettles, yerba packages and bombillas are set down with Shift + right click and lean toward where you look.$(br2)Right click with an empty hand to pick it up (the bombilla comes out separately).

Serve it right there:$(br2)Yerbera or loose yerba on an empty mate: fills it.$(br2)Sugar, milk bucket or yuyos: flavor it, before brewing.$(br2)Bombilla: it is stuck in separately and does not come out by itself.$(br2)Hot kettle: brews it (the bombilla must be in).
Unwashing: use a Brush on a washed mate to clear out the used yerba; it ends up empty and the bombilla returns to your inventory. The brush loses 1 durability.
